item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Hemant studies the diagram of square $ABCD$. Dashed segment $AC$ is a diagonal. Grey points $W$, $X$, $Y$, $Z$ are the midpoints of the sides, joined to form square $WXYZ$.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims are correct?

options.A: Build a new square on diagonal $AC$ to double the area of $ABCD$.
options.B: Join midpoints $W$, $X$, $Y$, $Z$ to form square $WXYZ$ and halve the area of $ABCD$.
options.C: Join the midpoints to double the area, and build on diagonal $AC$ to halve it.
options.D: Treat every inscribed quadrilateral inside $ABCD$ as a half-area square.
